mapper.sql: s.member_id=#{owner} and s.status=1 and s.completed_at >= #{start} and s.completed_at < #{end} and s.completed_at <= #{asOf}
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(s.id),0) from topic_route_session s where
select count(*) from (select s.id from topic_route_session s where and s.id <= #{upper} limit 1001) bounded

select s.id as recordId, concat(left(date_format(s.completed_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f'),23),'+08:00') as completedAt, s.config_version as routeVersion, case when s.create_time is not null and s.completed_at >= s.create_time then timestampdiff(second,s.create_time,s.completed_at) else null end as elapsedSeconds, case when cms_topic.id is null then 'UNAVAILABLE' else 'AVAILABLE' end as routeAvailability, cms_topic.name as routeTitle from topic_route_session s left join cms_topic on cms_topic.id=s.topic_id and cms_topic.status=1 and cms_topic.user_status=1 and cms_topic.del_flag=0 and cms_topic.is_draft=0 and cms_topic.is_template=0 and (cms_topic.club_id is null or cms_topic.club_id=0 or exists (select 1 from club active_club where active_club.id=cms_topic.club_id and active_club.del_flag=0)) and and where and s.id <= #{upper} and s.id < #{before} order by s.id desc limit #{limit}
